description: Anthropic Claude Directory compatibility gates. They inspect the built artifact only and never add or remove files. Update this file when Anthropic's checklist changes.

DC-01.title: No export-ignore, export-subst, or filter attributes in any .gitattributes file

DC-03.title: Regular files only: no symbolic links, submodules, or Git LFS pointers

DC-04.title: File and folder names valid on Windows and macOS, without case-only collisions

DC-05.title: Size limits: non-image files under 256 KiB, every file under 5 MiB, at most 512 files

DC-06.title: Binary files limited to PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP images and fonts

DC-07.title: Remote MCP server URLs use https:// or wss://

DC-08.title: Every ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} path used by a hook exists inside the plugin

DC-09.title: README of at least 40 words outside code blocks and a LICENSE
